sn35.55:1.1: kathannu kho bhante, jānato kathaṃ passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchantīti?
sn35.55:1.2: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu, anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
sn35.55:1.3: rūpe anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
sn35.55:1.4: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
sn35.55:1.5: cakkhusamphassaṃ anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
sn35.55:1.6: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
sn35.55:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
sn35.55:1.16: evaṃ kho bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchantīti.
